notes.title: Loud Sounds Fix & Minor Improvements
notes.content:
🛠️ What’s New?

Minor balance adjustments and performance improvements.

Small optimizations to improve overall experience.

If you notice any new audio issues, please let me know!

notes.title: Black Light Kills - Update v1.1.0 Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Fixed Note Reading Stutter[/b]
You will no longer experience stuttering or freezing when reading notes in the game.

[b] Environmental Bug Fixes[/b]
Various visual and environmental issues across the map have been fixed. Stuttering problems have been resolved.

 [b]Missing Subtitles Added[/b]
Missing subtitles in some scenes have been added, allowing you to follow the dialogues more completely.
